name: Pong
summary: The classic paddle game, played in the notch
description:
Pong takes the notch over with a court, a ball and a CPU on the other side. Steer your paddle with the pointer or trackpad, click to serve and to pause, and play to 11.

Open it with Control-Option-P or the Play button on its shelf widget, which also keeps your record against the CPU and lets you pick how good the CPU is.
